prompt.title: A secret club
prompt.passage: Billy and Kate see a new club. They go to the room. A girl does paper-cutting there. Billy asks, “Is it a paper-cutting club?” The girl says, “No, it isn’t.” It is the Drama Club. Students make masks and put paper-cuts on clothes. Billy and Kate like drama, so they join the club.
